🧠 *kb-update*: 2 new false-alarm entries written to `kb/false-alarms.json` (triage cycle 2026-11-20 ~11:15Z)

1) `fa-2026-11-20-tcg3-headless-crawler-public-app-xhr-noise`, matches `for account: tcg3` on alert-frontend-errors.
   Monitor 77419271 fired on account tcg3: 50 status-0 "Failed to load" XHR errors in 6s (02:19Z) from one HeadlessChrome client on a Microsoft hosting IP (AS8075), no user identity, loading tcg3's public app page. 0 server-side errors. It's a crawler, the same mechanism as the 08-15 sommselection bingbot entry, now on a second account. Scoped to the account so it can't shadow ki-21.
   Evidence: https://app.datadoghq.com/logs?query=service%3Amethod-ui%20status%3Aerror%20%2Axhr%2A%20%40account_name%3Atcg3&from_ts=1795140600000&to_ts=1795142100000&live=false

2) `fa-2026-11-20-reportgenerationapi-heartbeat-healthcheck-not-polled`, matches `monitors/316588059`.
   The heartbeat monitor watches `get_/health/check`, which got 2 hourly points of traffic in 7 days. The real probe is `/api/v1/health/pdf`, and report/generate served normally on prod-report-03/04. The monitor sits in No Data permanently and can't detect an outage. Suggest CRM Experience repoint it.
   Evidence: https://app.datadoghq.com/metric/explorer?live=false&page=0&exp_metric=trace.aspnet.request.hits&exp_scope=service%3Adefault_web_site%2Freportgenerationapi%2Cenv%3Aprod&exp_agg=avg&start=1795147200&end=1795172700
